arguments.body: Hi Luca, your annual gas safety check is due before 16 October. We have booked HeatRight Ltd (Gas Safe registered) to visit on Tuesday 13 October, 9am-12pm, at 19 Victoria Park Road. This is your written notice of the visit. If that time doesn't suit, please reply or call us with another time before 16 October and we'll rearrange; nobody will enter without your agreement. Booking now keeps the certificate's anniversary date, and you'll get a copy of the record within 28 days of the check. Thank you.

If this time doesn't suit, please contact us to rearrange before 16 October. You will receive a copy of the record within 28 days of the check.

Booking early keeps the anniversary date, and Luca gets a copy within 28 days. Please let us know if the check cost is above your £300 limit; we'll call you first if so. If access can't be agreed before the 16th, the property will be out of compliance and we'll update you straight away.
